reviewer: Main creative agent; multi-pass direct visual inspection, not external human sign-off
scope: Reference-quality photographic materials, six continuous transitions, native Flow integration and readable editorial presentation

transitionReview.observation: Cup liquid lifts into an intermediate dark volume before red fruit material resolves. Photographic lighting and visual center remain coherent; this is an editorial transformation, not a literal physical process.
Skin halves retain fruit silhouette while separating; the inner pair remains in place. Tissue appearance is materially consistent with the source fruit.
Outer tissue withdraws and one seed turns through an edge-on pose. It is intentionally a face-turn rather than a transparent superposition of incompatible shapes.
Registered green/golden/roasted material retains contour and crease continuity. Final real-page review confirms separate light and dark reading fields during the transition.
Source-textured fragments emerge from the bean and gather around the shared liquid form. Previously dark U06 introductory text is now on its own light field before entering the viewport.
Liquid translates to the original coffee plane; rim and ceramic reappear around it. The final cup returns to the opening material without a separate object reset.

resolvedDuringReview: Transparent-edge accumulation and texture resampling changed at material boundaries; corrected with premultiplied compositing and a common sampling grid.
Some desktop objects were excessively cropped or crossed text; moved into chapter-specific negative space.
Phone chapter labels collided with the existing pinned navigation; native U01 and U05 layout padding refined without changing navigation ownership.
Whole-screen paper interpolation failed when dark U05 and light U06 coexisted; replaced with content-coordinate color regions consuming the same public reading facts.
Phone ambient objects overlapped long notes during manual scroll; added a component-owned edge mask while preserving full source materials.
limitations: Mobile ambient objects are deliberately cropped into an edge rail; full material study and desktop layout show complete objects.
Scientific material images are AI-generated explanatory illustrations, not measured specimens.
Visual acceptance is the creative agent's assessment, not the user's final aesthetic sign-off.
Physical phones, Safari and subjective audio listening were not tested.
A major content/typography reflow or a new theme requires recalibration and a new reading-boundary review.
